description:
National U.S. wage statistics by occupation from the Bureau of Labor Statistics OEWS survey: hourly mean and percentiles (10th, 25th, median, 75th, 90th), annual mean and median, and employment. Search by occupation text, e.g. 'software developers' or 'registered nurses', or by SOC code, e.g. 15-1252. Defaults to the latest survey year. Pair it with search_labor_rates to compare market wages with awarded GSA ceiling rates.
FREE tier: 20 calls per visitor per 24h. A GlobalGov plan with API access lifts the cap.

survey_year.description: OEWS survey year (May reference month); default latest.

name: get_wage_data
title: Get U.S. occupational wage data
